$comment: Społeczność (src/server/community.js, screens/community.js). sections: the parts of its drop-down list, in their order; soon marks one that is not open yet („Wkrótce”). ranking.size: how many characters the Ranking postaci shows. friends.max: the most Znajomi a character may have, and the most invitations it may have waiting. gift: the daily Upominek to a friend (one a day to each, by the Warsaw day). The receiver collects at most claimsPerDay a day, so as many Time Points too; one not collected waits keepDays days. Each gives timePoints Time Points and, at random, gold (goldChance) or one resource, more with the receiver's level: base + perLevel × level, rounded. trade: the Wymiana (src/server/trades.js). A player is online when the game asked the server within onlineSeconds; a proposal waits proposalSeconds for its answer and a trade idleMinutes for its next change; after rejectionsInRow proposals to one player turned down in a row the next waits pauseMinutes; an offer holds at most maxItems items from the bag.
